cases.summary: Independent hold is correct. The chapter names Xu Man (许曼, s0044) and his paternal grandfather Xu Jun Jishan (祖父峻/季山, s0045). s0045 does not contain 父, 许曼之父, or any personal name for the intervening generation; only 祖父 links Jun to Man. p072 is a structural kinship entailment, not a quotable named person.
cases.reason: Agree with reviewer hold: houhanshu:093:p072 cannot receive primary personal-name certification. Owned Chinese supports Xu Man (p013) and Xu Jun (p014) only. The descriptive surfaces 许曼之父 and 许峻之子 on p072 are model kinship labels, not text present in s0045; they must not be treated as primary quotations. Retain canonical cluster per_D573WNDND2ZV0X38SG1R with unresolved identity and entailed-generation claims; do not invent a father’s name from English glosses or from 父 in claim kinshipTerm metadata alone.
